text: {"status":"answered","answer":"The standard daily point-of-sale purchase limit on a Harbor debit card is $3,000, covering purchases in stores, online and by phone. This limit resets at midnight Eastern Time, and cash back received at a store counts toward this purchase limit rather than the ATM limit. Premier Checking cardholders may have higher limits based on their relationship with Harbor, per the Debit Card Limits and Controls guide (effective 2026-02-02).","cited_chunk_ids":["debit_card_limits::layout::B_structure::0001"],"reason":"The Debit Card Limits and Controls guide directly states the daily point-of-sale purchase limit and related conditions."}
